name: git absorb — Automatic Fixup Commits
description: Installs git-absorb, a tool to automatically absorb staged changes into their logical commits. Like 'git commit --fixup' but automatic. Also automatically repairs broken host paths in your git config and restores your SSH commit-signing key on every attach.

version.description: Version of git-absorb to install (latest, or specific version like 0.6.11)
